title: 1 Kings
author: The author is not named; the book draws on royal records and prophetic history.
date: From Solomon's reign through the divided monarchy to the ministry of Elijah.
audience: Israel and Judah, warning against idolatry and unfaithful leadership.
historicalSetting: First Kings begins with Solomon's wisdom and temple building, then traces decline through divided kingship, idolatry, and prophetic confrontation.
themes: The word of the Lord through prophets
keyVerse: 1 Kings 18:21 — "How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him."
christFocus: The failure of Israel's kings points to the need for Christ, the faithful King. The temple anticipates the presence of God ultimately revealed in Jesus Christ.
